waves.label: An orc warband on the flank

log.text: The company marches for Hillsvain Woods.

chronicle.text: Expedition 1: 5 squads (30 soldiers) march on The Hillsvain Host.
Sten Tollsen signs on with six footmen.
Tobias Hart signs on with six spearmen.
The Amberfeld Company makes camp at the edge of the Hillsvain Woods. Six squads answer the muster.
